headline: No scored news; lines drift as stories fade
body: A quiet day with no scored events. Earlier stories faded slightly, trimming the Contained and bright endings by hundredths of a point. With no fresh news, the board still reflects this week's GPT-5.6 launch and chip-industry results. Horizon Balance held at +0.78.
movers_note: No ending moved by as much as 0.05 points (all 0.0 at one decimal); changes were single hundredths from fading contributions.
